name: AdCreative.ai
summary: AI ad-creative and banner generation for performance marketers.
best_for: performance marketers and stores that test many ad variations across sizes and platforms and want on-brand creative volume without a designer bottleneck
skip_if: you run a handful of static ads a month (a designer or Canva covers it), or your bottleneck is offer/targeting rather than creative volume
honest_knock: The meter counts downloads, not campaigns — iterate seriously on ad variations and a 10-credit starter evaporates in an afternoon, which is exactly what iteration-heavy ad work does. And the honest fundamental: AI creatives give you volume and speed, but the offer and the hook still decide performance — a mediocre offer with 500 AI banners is 500 mediocre banners. Size the credit tier to your real testing cadence.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month for 10 credits and 1 brand
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-15, read on their own homepage pricing table) Credit-metered, where one credit is one downloaded creative, and there is no free plan — only a 7-day trial with 10 credits. Three families, each with several credit steps. Starter is 1 user throughout: $39 a month for 10 credits and 1 brand, $89 for 15 credits and 2 brands, $139 for 30 credits and $189 for 50. Professional is 10 users and 10 brands: $249 for 50 credits, $339 for 75 and $400 for 100. Ultimate is 20 users and 25 brands: $999 for 100 credits, $1,099 for 150 and $1,399 for 200. Credits expire at the end of each billing cycle and do not roll over.

compare_with.name: Atria or Canva
compare_with.why: Atria adds competitor ad intelligence; Canva is manual but unmetered — AdCreative's edge is brand-locked volume generation
